Dear Grace,

Thank you for your quotation for Oxytocin 10 IU/mL, 1 mL ampoule, under RFQ-SYN-0107.

To complete our review, could you please send us the following:

1. A certificate of analysis (CoA)
2. Confirmation of 2-8 °C storage and transport
3. The remaining shelf life at dispatch

We appreciate your help and look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
Procurement team
